request.prompt:
Add a DISTINCT READABLE INDIVIDUAL BORDER around EACH of the TWENTY AOTL skill images in this4column by5row sheet. Preserve the existing successful full-bleed painted artwork, twenty identities/order, close-up subject scale, mage/Cinder Thread style anchors and dark mature palette. This is primarily a FRAME finishing pass, not a new design of the images. Each square must have its OWN professionally illustrated World-of-Warcraft-like beveled metal icon frame. Use a high-contrast near-black outer outline, a substantial dark aged-metal bevel with clear lit top/left edges and recessed lower/right edges, subtle clipped/chamfered corners and one narrow inner highlight that separates artwork from frame. Frame width around3-4percent of each cell dimension, visibly substantial at32/64px but leaving artwork large inside. NO empty padding/letterboxing between frame and painting. Every painting fills its framed square interior right to the inner edge and remains deliberately cropped. No text, labels, numbers, hotkeys, cooldowns or fake UI, no extra big frame around the whole atlas. No gaps between cells beyond each cell's own border. The full twenty-cell atlas remains opaque, exactly4columns5rows, overall4:5.
A coherent dark iron/brass AOTL border family, with only RESTRAINED material tint on the narrow inner trim to help identify schools: fire=dark burnished copper/ember; frost=cold pale steel/icy blue; arcane=dark amethyst steel; gold-light=aged pale gold; physical=aged iron with muted brass corners. Avoid bright candy/neon borders, ornate clutter, chains, skull decorations or thick glowing rarity halos. Each icon is clearly separated and legible as its own button, like polished classic RPG skill icons. Keep crisply illustrated contours and material depth, no global grunge/noise/brush filter.
Exact row order and trim: row1 Cinder Thread copper, Glacial Stitch cold steel, Arcane Fold amethyst steel, Ashen Ward copper/brass; row2 Starfall Script pale gold, Solar Writ copper/gold, Winter Crown cold steel, Epoch Lance amethyst steel; row3 Echo Strike amethyst steel, Winterglass Pulse cold steel, Cinderwake copper, Dawnfall pale gold; row4 Slash iron/brass, Cleave iron/brass, Shield Charge iron/brass, Rallying Cry aged brass; row5 Sundering Standard iron/brass, Citadel Reprisal aged brass, Furnace Sweep copper, Ember Aura copper/brass. Frame every single cell, including top-left and bottom-right, consistently aligned with the same width. Artwork and skill subjects stay painted, crisp, clean, dark and full-square; preserve the original image details rather than applying a filter.
